description: This file defines a Java class 'BackgroundSyncActor' that functions as an Akka actor responsible for background synchronization tasks within the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages metadata streaming, progress tracking, and consistency checking for Thing data, utilizing Akka Streams, persistence, and configuration scaling. The class includes methods for stream management, progress updates, and handling inconsistencies, indicating a core role in the synchronization process.

classes.name: SyncEvent
classes.description: Inner class representing synchronization events, indicating inconsistencies or re-inconsistencies, used for logging and status reporting.

classes.name: ProgressReport
classes.description: Inner class used to report progress during metadata streaming, indicating whether progress has been persisted.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Akka Props for this actor.

methods.name: preEnhanceSleepingBehavior
methods.description: Defines actor behavior when in sleeping state, mainly ignoring certain messages.

methods.name: preEnhanceStreamingBehavior
methods.description: Defines the main streaming behavior for the actor.

methods.name: postEnhanceStatusReport
methods.description: Adds status information regarding synchronization progress.

methods.name: parseConfig
methods.description: Parses configuration settings specific to this actor.

methods.name: streamTerminated
methods.description: Handles cleanup and reset when data streams end.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Creates the main data source for synchronization tasks.

methods.name: streamMetadataFromLowerBound
methods.description: Streams metadata starting from a specific lower bound identifier.

methods.name: setProgress
methods.description: Updates progress state based on received report.

methods.name: bookmarkThingId
methods.description: Handles bookmarking of the current processing position.

methods.name: handleInconsistency
methods.description: Responds to detected inconsistencies in data.

methods.name: getLowerBoundSource
methods.description: Creates a data source starting from a stored bookmark.

methods.name: getPersistedMetadataSourceWithProgressReporting
methods.description: Creates a metadata source that reports progress as it streams data.

methods.name: getIndexedMetadataSource
methods.description: Creates a source for indexed metadata.

methods.name: wrapAsResumeSource
methods.description: Wraps a source with resume capability based on a lower bound.

methods.name: nextLowerBound
methods.description: Determines the next lower bound for streaming based on last metadata batch.
